reviews.title: Misleading subscription wording – Live View locked behind paywall
reviews.text:
downloaded Seeing to use with CCTV/security cameras for home security. The App Store description says you can “monitor your home in high definition video” and “see, hear, and speak to visitors from anywhere.” It then describes the subscription as a “cloud storage plan.”

That is misleading. After setting the cameras up, the app blocks Live View unless you pay for a subscription. Live View is not cloud storage — it is the basic function of a CCTV camera.

I expected to pay for optional cloud recording, playback, downloads or storage, but not just to view my cameras live. Without Live View, the cameras are not properly usable for home security.

The subscription wording needs to be much clearer. Customers should be told upfront that Live View requires payment. I would not recommend this app unless you are happy paying extra just to use basic camera features.

reviews.text: Is ok the People motion detection don’t work right is sometimes it do sometimes it don’t, people got be real close to the camera barely catches from the side walk and or like when the delivery driver approaches the house is already to late is recording when he leaving what’s up with that and yes I raised the sensitivity, Is only 10 seconds should be a option at least 15 seconds or more, then for each camera got paid for a iCloud subscription ridiculous, I won’t have this cameras for long until I found something better but at least is better than Arlo

reviews.title: Iffy at best
reviews.text: Subscription required for the features I was looking for. Customer service is just ai giving wrong advice and the device went offline over a week ago and there’s no way to reconnect to wifi or start the device up again  the app is bare bones and lacks a lot of quality of life features like removing all videos on certain days. Honestly if you’re looking for a doorbell that functions without higher amount of user input get a different one.

reviews.title: To many subscriptions
reviews.text: Yes it does its job I won’t deny that however the subscriptions are rather confusing. I’ve had this for just over a year now. I got a subscription beginning of November last year for a year but when I signed in during June of this year it told me to do another…. It had been so long that I forgot that it was a year that I payed upfront for and just went ahead and did the new one. I got a notification to say my first one is running out last week and I have just realised I have payed twice each month for just over 5 months. This really needs to be labelled much better to not mislead customers. As a student who simply uses these in the kitchen to make sure house mates don’t take others food I don’t have the money to do that, yes I made it work but that was by reducing things and putting of things such as food shop a week to do the subscription. Now knowing I didn’t have to do that is upsetting to me.
